assertions.assertion: The patient presents with recurrent episodes of palpitations and lightheadedness, raising concern for an underlying cardiac arrhythmia in the context of a personal history of transient ischemic attacks and cerebral infarction.

Mobile cardiac telemetry (CPT 93229) is ordered to correlate these symptomatic events with rhythm disturbances and to evaluate for potential cardioembolic sources contributing to their transient cerebral ischemic attacks.
The indication explicitly documents symptoms, diagnoses (Z86.73, G45.9, I49.9), and the clinical rationale supporting the medical necessity of this service.
